question: Evidence gathered for F_b011_s030__NC (joint observed N/C scaffold context, 3 of 25 points): regional_context shows the support is three aromatic atoms (C index 6, C index 13, N index 22), with the N as the only acceptor; same-graph controls n=0 and same-root controls n=40 (dependent, not independent repeats).
